card.name: Conditions inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Single words in the middle of conditional dose-adjustment sentences, such as grade numbers, "normal", "gradually", "adequate", "may", "prior" and "or". They come just before the dose, timing or action the sentence goes on to name.

modes.label: Condition qualifiers
modes.description: A word describing the state that triggers a dose change, such as a grade, range or response.
modes.example: Discontinue 22 mg once daily after 16 weeks if<< adequate>> therapeutic response is not achieved.

modes.label: Linking words in dose steps
modes.description: Small connecting words in sentences about when or how to give the next dose.
modes.example: If anuria or marked oliguria (urinary output <0.6 mL/kg/hr) is evident at the scheduled time of the second<< or>> third dose of Ibuprofen Lys

modes.label: Adverb before action
modes.description: A word like gradually or prior that comes right before an instructed action.
